item.title: We’re expanding the Claude Startups program to help founders build
Claude now works with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides
item.description: Teams that run on Google Workspace can now bring Claude into their files or work on their files directly from Claude, with our new add-on and Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides connectors (in beta).

item.title: How Comcast and Booz Allen use Claude Mythos to find exploit chains and secure their codebases
item.description: Security teams at Comcast and Booz Allen used Claude Mythos-class models through Project Glasswing to find, validate, and fix vulnerabilities their existing scanners missed.

item.title: How Block orchestrates Claude Fable across thousands of pull requests
item.description: Bradley Axen, Head of AI Capabilities at Block, on how his team evaluates new large language models, how Claude Fable 5 orchestrates company-wide code migrations, and why safeguards are a critical part of deploying frontier intelligence responsibly, at scale.

item.title: Uber's CISO on building an insider threat program for AI
item.description: Uber's CISO, Philip Martin, on the importance of monitoring and observability for AI agents, and how Uber's open-source tooling works alongside Enterprise Frontier Safeguards.

item.title: Build live dashboards and animate explainers with Claude
item.description: Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are now in beta. Docs, Slides, and Design are out of beta and on every Claude plan, including Free.
